from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Extraction from one document in the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this specific document/paper")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers that this paper explicitly references/cites in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
